question: Should OpenClaw accept a public reset-start prompt override, and if so should it be a full `session.resetPrompt` replacement, part of `agents.defaults.startupContext`, or folded into the broader reset greeting/model configuration?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but root AGENTS.md and VISION.md treat new config/default surfaces as high-bar product contracts, and related open issues overlap on reset greeting behavior.

options.title: Approve a focused prompt override
options.body: Add one canonical full-replacement reset prompt surface with default fallback, docs, and tests that define how current-time and bootstrap behavior interact with the custom prompt.

options.title: Fold into broader reset greeting settings
options.body: Keep this issue open but resolve it through the broader reset greeting/model/suppression design so OpenClaw does not grow parallel reset-start knobs.

options.title: Decline a new config key
options.body: Document the existing startupContext and hook alternatives and close the prompt-override direction as too much config surface for core.

recommendation.title: Approve a focused prompt override
recommendation.body: Add one canonical full-replacement reset prompt surface with default fallback, docs, and tests that define how current-time and bootstrap behavior interact with the custom prompt.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and release history place the reset prompt, config schema, and reset-start docs in this area under vincentkoc's recent changes.
